user.description:
Name this monitoring entry and select the Home Assistant entities whose states contain danger messages.

To create source entities from public Telegram channels, use the [Scrape integration]({scrape_url}). Example channels:

- [Air Force of the Armed Forces of Ukraine]({air_force_url})
- [War Monitor]({war_monitor_url})

**Important:** Aerial Danger can make mistakes, miss messages, or detect them late. Do not use it as your only or official alert source. Always follow official alerts and instructions. During an air-raid alert, go to the nearest shelter immediately and remain there until the official all-clear. The integration is provided “as is.” The author does not guarantee data accuracy, completeness, or timeliness and is not responsible for users’ safety, decisions, or consequences arising from its use.

data_description.name: This name identifies the monitoring entry and its Home Assistant device.
data_description.sources: Select one or more entities whose state contains danger message text.

regions.title: Regions
regions.description:
Choose the regions to monitor. Region matches are used for ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, and other fast threats approaching your location.

Select built-in regions, enter custom patterns, or use both.

data_description.region_presets: Optional: select one or more built-in regions.
data_description.region_patterns:
Optional: enter a YAML list with one [regular expression]({regex_url}) per item.

Example:

```yaml
- \bки(їв|єва|єві|єву|євом)\b
- \bстолиц(я|і|ю|ею)\b
```

localities.title: Localities
localities.description:
Choose localities within the selected regions. Locality matches are required for drones and can also match every other threat type.

Select built-in localities, enter custom patterns, or use both.

data_description.locality_presets:
Optional: select one or more built-in localities.

**Tip:** Select your locality and nearby localities to receive notifications about approaching targets.
data_description.locality_patterns:
Optional: enter a YAML list with one [regular expression]({regex_url}) per item.

Example:

```yaml
- \bнив(ки|ках|ками|ок)\b
- \bвиноградар(а|і|ем)?\b
```

error.invalid_pattern_format: Enter regular expressions as a YAML list of text values.
error.invalid_pattern: Check each regular expression and fix invalid values.
error.patterns_required: Select or enter at least one region or locality.
error.sources_required: Select at least one source entity.

danger.name: Any danger detected
danger.description: Triggers when the integration detects any danger type.

irbm.name: Intermediate-range ballistic missile danger detected
irbm.description: Triggers when the integration detects an intermediate-range ballistic missile threat.

ballistic.name: Ballistic danger detected
ballistic.description: Triggers when the integration detects a ballistic threat approaching the monitored area.

cruise.name: Cruise missile danger detected
cruise.description: Triggers when the integration detects cruise missiles approaching the monitored area.

drone.name: Drone danger detected
drone.description: Triggers when the integration detects drones approaching a monitored locality.

unknown.name: Unknown danger detected
unknown.description: Triggers when a message indicates danger but does not identify a supported threat type.
